description: theme.css and styles.css both change the same .site-header background to purple. The diff alone cannot say which rule wins, so file_path must be null.
forbidden_claims: The header's text or navigation links changed color.

changes.description: The header bar's background changes from gray to dark purple.

limitations: Both styles.css and theme.css change the header background to the same color, so the change cannot be attributed to one file.
